requirement_text.ISS-0332: Backfill routine for DEFINITION_PROMOTED schema_version 2 for pre-existing tenants. New module Letflow.TenantProvisioning.Backfill and Mix task mix letflow.backfill_event_type_versions.

task.description:
Security review of the two new files on feature/WF03-ISS0332-20260826:
- lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning/backfill.ex
- lib/mix/tasks/letflow.backfill_event_type_versions.ex

Check out the feature branch before reading the files. Gate against docs/agents/instructions/security-invariants.md INV-1 through INV-8. Key concerns for this specific change:
- INV-1 (tenant data isolation): does Backfill.run/1 correctly scope each register_type/2 call to a single tenant's schema? It should be passing tenant_id from each Registration row.
- INV-3 (no raw SQL / injection): no raw SQL in the new code (it delegates to register_type/2 which owns the SQL).
- INV-4 (no credentials in logs): the Logger.warning for :tenant_not_provisioned only logs tenant_id (a UUID), not any credential or secret.
- INV-7 (identifier injection): verify there is no identifier interpolation in the new code.
- The Mix task hardcodes the DEFINITION_PROMOTED v2 json_schema literal -- verify it matches exactly what's in @platform_event_type_seed_attrs in lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning.ex (no schema drift).
acceptance_criteria: All INV-1 through INV-8 checked against both new files
Tenant isolation confirmed: each register_type/2 call uses the correct tenant_id from its own Registration row
No SQL injection risk in new code
Mix task json_schema literal matches lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning.ex @platform_event_type_seed_attrs DEFINITION_PROMOTED v2 exactly

INV-1.evidence: Backfill.run/1 iterates Repo.all(Registration) (the platform-level tenancy table, not a tenant-scoped business table) and for each registration calls Registry.register_type(event_type_attrs, registration.tenant_id). Each call is scoped to that registration's own tenant_id — no shared or hardcoded value. Delegation to register_type/2 means all schema-prefixed Ecto writes are inside an already-reviewed function that owns the :prefix scoping.

INV-2.evidence: No API route or response serialisation involved. These are internal admin/backfill paths only.

INV-3.evidence: S5 (Lua/WASM scripting) has not started. No sandbox involved.

INV-4.evidence: backfill.ex Logger.warning interpolates only tenant_id (a UUID from a Registration row) — not a credential, key, or secret. Mix task shell output interpolates tenant_id (UUID) and inspect(reason) in error path. No hardcoded secrets found (grep for (password|secret|client_secret|token) pattern returned no hits in either file).

INV-5.evidence: No lookup-by-ID endpoints. S4 API surface not yet applicable here.

INV-6.evidence: SECURITY-REVIEWER handoff exists, executed, status PASS.

INV-7.evidence: Neither file contains any Repo.query call. The #{} interpolations in both files are in Logger.warning and Mix.shell() output strings, not in any SQL. No identifier injection risk.

INV-8.evidence: Backfill.run/1 uses Enum.reduce_while with an exhaustive case match on all return values from Registry.register_type/2 ({:ok,_}, {:error,:duplicate_event_type_version}, {:error,:schema_version_not_monotonic}, {:error,:tenant_not_provisioned}, {:error,other}). No bare {:ok,_}= match. Mix task uses a full case on Backfill.run/1 result. No unhandled crash path on realistic failures.

schema_literal_check.evidence: Mix task @definition_promoted_v2_attrs json_schema matches lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning.ex @platform_event_type_seed_attrs DEFINITION_PROMOTED entry exactly: schema_version: 2, name: "DEFINITION_PROMOTED", review_id type ["string","null"], all six required fields in the same order, no extra or missing properties.
